skill_name: Explain why single cell organisms are simpler than multicellular organisms.
workflow: Single-celled organisms are simpler than multicellular organisms because they do not require complex organ systems to function. Single-celled organisms are autonomous and able to survive on their own, while multicellular organisms require cooperation between cells in order to survive. Single-celled organisms rely on their own machinery to perform all necessary functions, while multicellular organisms require a sophisticated network of cells working together to maintain basic needs.
